headline: 172 measures in 40 jurisdictions: labels and notices of AI use
text:
Here is how your fear of AI is being used to centralize power today.

172 measures in 40 jurisdictions would require a label, watermark, or disclosure on AI content, or a notice to the people AI is used on.

106 measures in 27 states would require a company to file reports with a government body, or hand them over on demand.

2,272 measures tracked. 760 carry a control, and they would hand new power to 100 offices.
